name: Kardemir Celik Sanayi AS
summary: Kardemir Celik Sanayi AS manufactures and sells steel products in Turkey. It offers products, such as billet iron, film rod, reinforcement steel, equal-sided angle bar, lama iron, tracked lama iron, round iron, square iron, tracked square iron, t-iron, ipe profile, ipn  rsj profiles, upn/uac profile, w profile, and c profile. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Denizli, Turkey.
